# `tax_transaction`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

The tax engine transaction behind one prepaid charge (ABR): committed when the charge is booked, voided when the whole charge is credited.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Not the idempotency key; the key sent to the engine is derived from applied_rate_id. |
| `applied_rate_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `quote_id` | `text` | no |  | The engine's id of the quote that was committed. |
| `state` | `text` | no | `'committed'::text` |  |
| `address` | `jsonb` | no |  | The service address the tax was computed for; a later address change never alters a booked charge. |
| `lines` | `jsonb` | no |  | The tax lines as the engine answered (jurisdiction, taxCategory, taxRate, taxAmount). |
| `committed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `voided_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  |  |
